title: RBI Cuts RRB CRR and SLR Exemption Deadline to August 31, 2026
description: RBI amends RRB CRR and SLR Directions, reducing the exemption period for fresh FCNR(B) and NRE deposits to August 31, 2026.The post RBI Cuts RRB CRR and SLR Exemption Deadline to August 31, 2026 appeared first on TaxGuru.
